svg.aria-label: Why reconciliation is a key spine and not a join
svg.title: Why reconciliation is a key spine and not a join
svg.text: Why reconciliation is a key spine and not a join
A LEFT JOIN answers 'what matched'. A finance team needs 'what is missing', which is a different question and a different shape.

svg.text: WHAT A LEFT JOIN WOULD HAVE DONE

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: LEFT JOIN payments -> settlement silently drops a bank line for a payment the till never

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: recorded -- exactly the row a fraud or a mis-keyed refund produces. The total still balances,

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: because the missing money was never in the sum. That is the failure mode this shape removes.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
